raw_contexts.title: Jianyang, Sichuan
raw_contexts.paragraph_text: Jianyang () is a county-level city located in the Sichuan basin in Sichuan Province, in south central China. Situated only 48 kilometers south east of the city center of Chengdu, Jianyang is administratively under the jurisdiction of Chengdu since May 2016. The urban center is located on the banks of the Tuo River.

raw_contexts.title: Jianyang Railway Station
raw_contexts.paragraph_text: The Jianyang Railway Station() is a railway station of Chengdu–Chongqing Railway. The station located in Jianyang, Ziyang, Sichuan, China.

raw_contexts.title: Jianyang Middle School
raw_contexts.paragraph_text: Sichuan Sheng Jianyang Middle School (Chinese四川省简阳中学;Pinyin: Sìchuān shěng jiǎnyáng zhōngxué ) is a school for middle level education located in Jianyang, Sichuan. The school which was founded in the year 1899 now has two campuses, with a large number of students over 10000 and 135 classes, on the two sides of Tuo River . It covers an area of 300 acres(about 0.2k㎡).

raw_contexts.paragraph_text: Jianyang (Northern Min: Gṳ̿ing-iô̤ng-dī / 建陽事 ) is a dialect of Northern Min Chinese spoken in Jianyang in the north of Fujian province.

raw_contexts.title: Jianyang District
raw_contexts.paragraph_text: Jianyang is a district in Nanping prefecture in the northern part of Fujian province, People's Republic of China.

raw_contexts.title: Datong Yungang Airport
raw_contexts.paragraph_text: Datong Yungang Airport () (IATA: DAT, ICAO: ZBDT) is an airport serving the city of Datong in Shanxi Province, China. It is located north of the town of Beijiazao in Datong County, 15.2 kilometers from the city center.
